postgres.comment: Read-only access to Supabase Postgres prod DB via claude_readonly role. Loads only when SUPABASE_READONLY_URL is exported. Falls back unused if env missing — no boot crash. See docs/engineering/R-Q1-E-014-sentry-postgres-mcp-handoff.md.

sentry.comment: Sentry MCP — reads issues / events / replays from sentry.io. Read-only on the token scope set in account. Loads only when SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN exported. See docs/engineering/R-Q1-E-014-sentry-postgres-mcp-handoff.md.
